'''Magic of the Holocron''' is a featurette included in the Blu-ray and DVD release of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]]. It covers the development of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|season two]] episodes "[[Holocron Heist]]," "[[Cargo of Doom]]" and "[[Children of the Force]]."

The featurette is divided into six thematics:
*[[Holocron|Creating a McGuffin]]
*[[Holocron Heist]]
*[[Todo 360]]
*[[Cato Parasitti]]
*[[Cargo of Doom]]
*[[Children of the Force]]
